title: ukraine_allies_short
question: Is Ukraine pushing its allies too far? Comment below

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: South Korea just *pulled its ambassador* out of Ukraine. The first recall since 2008.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Seoul says Zelensky revealed a *secret transfer* of two North Korean POWs, putting their families at risk.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Kyiv's answer? *I consider this matter already closed*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Trump told Kyiv to stop hitting Russian refineries. *He better damn well stop*, he said. Ukraine kept hitting them.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Slovakia accused Zelensky of *blocking its oil*. It cut off emergency power to Ukraine.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Zelensky told Japan its support *wasn't as significant as it could have been*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Japan pledged about *six billion dollars* for this year alone.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: And when Poland stripped him of its *highest honor*, Zelensky *mailed it back*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: The reason: Zelensky named an army unit after the *UPA*, a force behind the mass killing of Poles in World War Two.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Is Ukraine pushing its friends *too far*? Tell us in the comments.
